{{Quote|He's dying, Mix. I'll do what I can, but it might not be enough.|MD-0C6, to Mix Liddell, on Byrch Dyshkava|<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>}}
'''MD-0C6''', commonly known as '''Doc''', was a self-customized [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series medical droid]] and the local [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] in [[Bartyn's Landing]], a coastal [[City/Legends|town]] on [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Initially the property of an employee of the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]], MD-0C6 eventually became an independent [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. After not receiving a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] for over five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], MD-0C6 developed personality quirks and, as the only doctor in the city, became a well-respected member of his community, known for his strict priorities&mdash;namely, the patient's health before anything else. At some point during his career, MD-0C6 obtained a small, hovering medical assistant, designated [[F-RTZ-2]], or "Fritz."

Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, MD-0C6 saved the life of a young [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Security Chief's Second|policeman]], [[Mix Liddell]], after Liddell's [[Raid to Dyshkava's camp|encounter]] with the outlaw [[Byrch Dyshkava|Byrch "The Padawan" Dyshkava]]. After this event, the gruff droid befriended then&ndash;[[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] Liddell, and they made several sailing trips together. Forty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, a few years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Liddell brought a wounded Dyshkava to MD-0C6 to see whether the droid could save the criminal's life.

==Biography==
MD-0C6 was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] from the [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series of medical specialists]]<ref name="BL" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="AEG" /> The droid claimed that he was the property of an employee of [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]] (ORO). His master worked for the [[exploratory branch of Outer Rim Oreworks]] and was a trusted member of a team led by [[Hugo Bartyn]], an entrepreneurial, ambitious ORO scout.<ref name="BL" /> During an expedition for which MD-0C6 served as chief medical [[Droid/Legends|droid]],<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|II|298&ndash;299|MD-0C6}}</ref> the team discovered that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] could be a profitable investment for ORO, and they convinced the company to buy it for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] purposes. Bartyn, however, actually wanted to build his own coastal town and enrich himself by fishing.<ref name="BL" /> Over five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later, a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="R" /> of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> MD-0C6 claimed that it was he who had come up with the name "[[Bartyn's Landing]]" for the town, but this statement was controversial.<ref name="BL" />

[[File:Bartyns_Landing_cover.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Bartyn's Landing was MD-0C6's home]]
MD-0C6 became the medical droid for the town's original settlers and [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="BL" /> He eventually became an independent droid, but he continued with his work as a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]<ref name="BL" /><ref name="CE" /> using his [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]].<ref name="BL" /> The community eventually nicknamed him "Doc,"<ref name="BL" /><ref name="CE" /> and the droid came to be respected by the locals. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], he also improved his own robotic body with the available parts and obtained a medical assistant in the form of the little hovering droid designated [[F-RTZ-2]] and nicknamed "Fritz."<ref name="BL" />

Some time later, MD-0C6 healed [[Mix Liddell]], a young [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Security Chief's Second|junior constable]]&mdash;or "Second"&mdash;and the only survivor of a [[Raid to Dyshkava's camp|raid]] against [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and outlaw leader [[Byrch Dyshkava|Byrch "The Padawan" Dyshkava]]. After spending time in a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] tank, Liddell returned to work and became the [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]], arresting Dyshkava. Dyshkava escaped, but the threat that he posed had ended. Liddell became a well-liked sheriff in the community and a personal friend to MD-0C6, and he and the droid often made sailing trips together. The droid considered Liddell to be the best constable that the Landing had had in all its history<ref name="BL" />&mdash;of which MD-0C6 had been a witness.<ref name="BL" /><ref name="CE" />

Forty years later, a few years before the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="R" /> a [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] plague devastated the remote community of [[Little Mon Cal]] on the other side of the planet. MD-0C6 and some security agents traveled there by [[Boat/Legends|boat]] to deliver much-needed medical supplies. They had an encounter with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who wanted to steal the valuable cargo and hold it for ransom.<ref name="BL" />

Later that year, Dyshkava returned to Bartyn's Landing and was severely injured in a duel. Liddell found Dyshkava and took him to a cell, but he also called for MD-0C6 so that Dyshkava could receive medical care. MD-0C6 and F-RTZ-2 did their best, but the MD admitted that it could be too late to save Dyshkava. Although Dyshkava awoke and was questioned by Liddell, MD-0C6 insisted on making his patient rest. As a consequence of Dyshkava's reappearance, Liddell hired some new Seconds, and MD-0C6 provided them with the few [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] he could spare.<ref name="R" />

==Characteristics==
With a personality that developed over at least five centuries, MD-0C6 exhibited several character traits, including gruffness. However, people around him knew that he was only rough for his patients' benefit: MD-0C6 rudely expelled anyone who might disturb an ill person's rest, and he could be abrupt with a patient exhibiting self-destructive behavior. His patients were his utmost priority; an attitude that led the inhabitants of Bartyn's Landing to like him<ref name="BL" /> to the point that the droid participated in the town's management.<ref name="CE" /> While at work, MD-0C6 accepted the help of qualified organics, although he grumbled all the while.<ref name="R" /> Other droids considered MD-0C6's curmudgeonly personality to be quaint.<ref name="CE" /> MD-0C6 was fluent in both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Binary/Legends|binary]] [[Language/Legends|languages]].<ref name="BL" />

Unlike most droids, MD-0C6 liked [[Water/Legends|water]]. He owned a [[repulsorsail skiff]] and enjoyed sailing along with his friend, Mix Liddell, whenever he was not on duty. He stayed in touch with F-RTZ-2 via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] during these trips in case MD-0C6's skills were needed.<ref name="BL" />

==Description==
MD-0C6 generally looked like an Industrial Automaton MD-series droid, and as such he was equipped with the common parts of a droid that model, including a diagnostic package, a heuristic processor, an improved sensor package, a medical diagnosis computer, a translator unit, and a vocabulator. Throughout his long life, MD-0C6 added several available parts to himself, including [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-resistant [[Armor/Legends|armor]]; a retractile, shoulder-mounted blaster; increased storage space; and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] units from an old [[speederboat]] to increase his own mobility. Except for the repulsor unit that replaced his lower half, most of these modifications were not apparent at a glance.<ref name="BL" />

==Behind the scenes==
MD-0C6 was created by writer [[Cory J. Herndon]] and was featured in the article [[Bartyn's Landing (article)|''Bartyn's Landing'']]<ref name="BL" /> and in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Reckonings]]'', both of which were published in the magazine [[Star Wars Gamer 7|''Star Wars Gamer'' #7]] ([[2001]]).<ref name="R" /> He had an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]) that included some new information and contradicted ''Star Wars Gamer'' by saying that MD-0C6 had had regular memory wipes.<ref name="CE" /> This article considers that piece of information a typo, because MD-0C6 not having had memory wipes was an essential part of the character's background in the ''Bartyn's Landing'' article.<ref name="BL" />
